# Agent Prompts Directory

This directory contains prompts for orchestrating the Zero-to-Running Developer Environment implementation.

## Files

- **MASTER_AGENT_PROMPT.md** - Prompt for the master orchestrator agent
  - Spawns and manages sub-agents
  - Coordinates handoffs between agents
  - Ensures quality gates are met

## Future Files (Generated by Master Agent)

As the master agent spawns sub-agents, it will generate specific prompts here:
- `DXS_PROMPT.md` - Dev Experience & Scaffolder agent prompt
- `A&D_PROMPT.md` - App & Data agent prompt
- `C&C_PART1_PROMPT.md` - Containers & Cloud Part 1 (Local Dev) prompt
- `C&C_PART2_PROMPT.md` - Containers & Cloud Part 2 (GKE Deployment) prompt
- `D&D_PROMPT.md` - Docs & Demo agent prompt

## Usage

1. Copy `MASTER_AGENT_PROMPT.md` into a new chat window
2. Master agent will generate sub-agent prompts as needed
3. Each sub-agent prompt will reference PRD_1, PRD_2, and IMPLEMENTATION_GUIDE

---

**Note**: The master agent prompt contains full context summary - no need to load other files when starting.
